title: Composition, pentagon and proper coincidence of integral projections
statement: For the datum S of [def-fix-six-functor-datum], the actual integral compact-support projection of [def-sf-constructible-projection-mates] satisfies precisely the composition, associativity-pentagon and proper-coincidence equations displayed in CompactSupportProjectionLaws, with its recorded support, pullback, tensor and comparison functors. The composition and proper equations hold for arbitrary bounded constructible first input and uniformly finite-Tor second input. The pentagon holds for every bounded constructible input. This statement excludes invertibility, naturality and compactification-independence clauses.

source.place: Integral projection: normalized reductions and coherent-system realization

proof.text: Lift every reduction to finite Tor. Choose natural tensor coordinates normalized with respect to the individual compactification and proper counit projections. These are primitive coefficient-change squares, not the structural identities being proved.

source.place: Successive coefficient reductions, integral reconstruction, and coherence

proof.text: For composition, use naturality of the support comparison at the inner projection, the two individual projection squares, finite projection naturality in both variables, and the recorded support-composition and pull-composition coefficient squares. Cancellation of endpoint isomorphisms leaves exactly the finite projection-composition equation. For the pentagon, normalize both paths with support-composition comparison and naturality, then use the finite pentagon with the specified Category.assoc transport. For proper coincidence, use tensor naturality, both individual projection squares, and coefficient compatibility of properIdentification (compactification comparison followed by properIdentity); the finite proper equation finishes.

theorem integralStageProjection_structuralIdentities
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} {C : D.CoefficientDatum}
    {E : Type u} [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E] {n : ℕ} {hn : 1 ≤ n}
    (d : SixFunctorOperationDatum D C E n hn) :
    let B := fun X : SixFunctorSpace D ↦ sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E X.obj.left
    let S := d.higher.integral
    let T := d.higher.integralTensor
    let A := d.higher.integralExchange
    let P := d.integralFiniteTorDomain
    (∀ {X Y Z : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    [IsSeparated f.hom.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType f.hom.left] [QuasiCompact f.hom.left]
    [IsSeparated g.hom.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType g.hom.left] [QuasiCompact g.hom.left]
    (cf : Compactification f.hom.left) (cg : Compactification g.hom.left)
    (cfg : Compactification (f ≫ g).hom.left) (K : B X) (L : B Z), P Z L →
      ((T Z).map ((S.composition f g cf cg cfg).hom.app K)).app L ≫
          compactSupportProjectionComponent A g cg ((S.support f cf).obj K) L ≫
          (S.support g cg).map
            (compactSupportProjectionComponent A f cf K ((S.pull g).obj L)) =
        compactSupportProjectionComponent A (f ≫ g) cfg K L ≫
          (S.composition f g cf cg cfg).hom.app
            (((T X).obj K).obj ((S.pull (f ≫ g)).obj L)) ≫
          (S.support g cg).map ((S.support f cf).map
            (((T X).obj K).map ((S.pullComposition f g).hom.app L)))) ∧
    (∀ {X Y Z W : SixFunctorSpace D}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (h : Z ⟶ W)
    [IsSeparated f.hom.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType f.hom.left] [QuasiCompact f.hom.left]
    [IsSeparated g.hom.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType g.hom.left] [QuasiCompact g.hom.left]
    [IsSeparated h.hom.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType h.hom.left] [QuasiCompact h.hom.left]
    (cf : Compactification f.hom.left) (cg : Compactification g.hom.left)
    (ch : Compactification h.hom.left) (cfg : Compactification (f ≫ g).hom.left)
    (cgh : Compactification (g ≫ h).hom.left)
    (cfgh : Compactification ((f ≫ g) ≫ h).hom.left) (K : B X),
    HEq ((S.composition (f ≫ g) h cfg ch cfgh).hom.app K ≫
      (S.support h ch).map ((S.composition f g cf cg cfg).hom.app K))
      ((S.composition f (g ≫ h) cf cgh
        (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun t : X ⟶ W ↦ Compactification t.hom.left)
          (Category.assoc f g h)) cfgh)).hom.app K ≫
        (S.composition g h cg ch cgh).hom.app ((S.support f cf).obj K))) ∧
    (∀ {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f.hom.left]
    (c : Compactification f.hom.left) (K : B X) (L : B Y), P Y L →
      ((T Y).map ((S.properIdentification f c).hom.app K)).app L ≫
          compactSupportProperProjection A f K L =
        compactSupportProjectionComponent A f c K L ≫
          (S.properIdentification f c).hom.app
            (((T X).obj K).obj ((S.pull f).obj L)))
